name: Artificial Intimacy
source:
Every breakup can be hard, but how far is someone willing to go just to not be alone anymore? Follow Sera's story as she finds out if an artificial love can mend the wounds in her heart, or if it'll only make the pain last longer. 

[From [url=https://sukebanchor18.itch.io/artificial-intimacy]itch.io[/url]]
